decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established heat-exchanger range in a growing market, its early presence on the website gives no sign of performance below aspiration, and the firm's broad portfolio and R&D slack support continued trial.
Reported major market share and high quality clearly indicate performance above aspiration, so behavioral theory predicts strong continuation rather than problemistic search away from the product.

A dedicated product page suggests organizational commitment, and because it builds on existing marine cooling capabilities the firm is likely to retain it while learning accumulates rather than exit quickly.
Although only briefly mentioned and still very new, it fits the firm's core engineering base and there is no evidence of a shortfall severe enough to justify redeploying resources within a year.
Its own page and strong fit with the firm's air-cooling offer suggest expectations of strategic relevance, and available organizational slack makes early withdrawal unlikely.
As an incremental, capability-based improvement with dedicated presentation, it is likely to be kept while the firm evaluates market response against aspirations over a longer horizon.
